description: This file contains code for generating trace type functions and registration code for PyTorch's autograd system, including templates, function definitions, and sharding logic.

methods.name: type_wrapper_name
methods.description: Generates a unique function name for trace type functions, optionally per autograd dispatch key.

methods.name: method_definition
methods.description: Creates the C++ method definition for a native function, including trace body.

methods.name: method_registration
methods.description: Creates registration code for the trace type method.

methods.name: gen_trace_type_func
methods.description: Generates header includes, method definitions, and registration code for a native function.

methods.name: gen_trace_type
methods.description: Generates sharded C++ source files for trace type functions, excluding manual tracer functions.
